assassin_displacement_policy.basic_speed_timing: speed multiplier applies only future normal-attack windup/recovery, ceil(original_steps*10000/multiplier), minimum1step; active hit offsets unchanged. assassin_displacement_policy.stat_buff_order: flat attack/evasion added once as a named source before respective rage/weakening or23accuracy test; same family strongest not sum; both evasion skills give at most50. Single-source reapply replaces duration, no duration addition.
assassin_displacement_policy.stealth_network: same visible ally character remains marked for party/self; hostile AI acquisition uses actual detection policy. Room chat/profile identity not hidden. assassin_displacement_policy.displacement: sweep current character collision along intended vector with actual navigation/water/gates/height policy; first obstruction stops at last legal position, no full-distance teleport behind wall. assassin_displacement_policy.interaction: movement cancels click-path and clears pending service interaction; never auto activates portal/gather/quest. Normal hostile damage still applies, geometry used for subsequent hit checks. Existing DoT continues.
assassin_displacement_policy.persistence: Standalone buffs/stealth retain their original source, remaining steps and cooldown. The adopted24-field displacement action retains frozen profile/direction, elapsed_steps, first-obstruction advance event reference and original lifecycle stop reference. Distance/remaining phase steps derive from this root, position belongs only to world character location. No second position, remaining distance, blocked bool or motion log. Normal save waits action end; activity snapshot retains the action and world position atomically. Pause/offline freeze; LAN host commits. Death clears occupation without refunding cost or cooldown. Full player occupation union and input/phase parents remain pending.
assassin_displacement_policy.other_sources: detection abilities and attack-speed passives need own explicit profiles; missing definitions never default to invulnerable/full-distance blink

displacement_fixed_step_policy.scope: Only effect.handler=swept_self_displacement in assassin_displacement_definitions uses this movement policy: 瞬移6000mm/6 movement steps, 移形换位4000mm/12, 缩地术3000mm/6. The other five entries are buffs; they never gain displacement from this family name.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.acceptance: Freeze normalized directional intent or current forward for 瞬移/缩地术; 移形换位 always freezes backward from accepted facing. Precast requires a continuous straight legal sweep of at least250mm in that direction using the real0.35m player footprint. This is an eligibility check, not reserved terrain or a frozen future endpoint. Reject before costs/cooldown if it fails; a successful action clears the normal combo window along its original owner.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.timing: Acceptance T starts elapsed action step0 and occupies the actor, without movement. The subsequent six actual scope steps are cast steps1..6. For movement_steps=M, steps7..6+M each receive distance_mm/M budget; the following12 steps are recovery. Completion is at elapsed6+M+12. No movement at acceptance, cast or recovery; no ordinary or automatic translation during any occupied step.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.fractional_budget: Use exact per-step distance before converting to finite Godot coordinates: 瞬移1000mm, 缩地术500mm, 移形换位1000/3mm. Do not floor archer motion to333mm, accumulate missing fractions in a second distance field, or refill a step after collision.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.obstruction: Continuous straight sweep stops at first actual obstruction, without dodge wall sliding. A partial or zero movement at that obstruction sets movement_blocked_event_id_or_null to this original advance event ID and consumes the current phase step; all later movement steps stay at the actual position. Retain the original cast/movement/recovery clock through completion, with no refund, restart, redirected path or later resumption if the obstacle disappears.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.combat: No added invulnerability in cast, movement or recovery. After the actor movement phase, ordinary direct attacks use the actual resulting position; DoT continues. Death or another explicitly adopted interrupt terminates the action, preserving already paid cost and cooldown. A missing interrupt rule does not authorize another action to replace it.
displacement_fixed_step_policy.authority: One original movement owner per actor/T, mutually exclusive with manual/automatic/dodge translation. Reuse player on-foot collision eligibility and world position owner, but not its sliding or speed formulas. Original phase parent authenticates accepted profile, before position, elapsed step, obstruction and after position atomically; replay returns that result. Request/action/admission/advance schemas are adopted; complete occupation union and original full parent context remain D1 work.

displacement_advance_binding.result: 十二键结果原world/scope/source/action/T严格同根，path首尾即原位置before/after、有限真实地面。前摇/后摇及已有movement_blocked引用时仅单点、hit_obstruction=false。合法移动步沿原方向连续直线水平扫掠，不墙滑；无接触时预算全走，首次实际障碍时可短走或原地，hit_obstruction=true且同父将根movement_blocked引用由null写本event_id。以后只推进动作步，不重新检测后恢复位移。 三种动作均保原before朝向，不按后退向量/墙接触或后续镜头转身；属于本项目采用，移动方向不等于转身命令，故推进结果不新增after_yaw副本。
displacement_advance_binding.budget: 预算仅原distance_mm/movement_steps毫米：1000、1000/3、500；不按普通速度或delta，不整毫米取整或保存分数余量。每步路径真实水平总长不得超预算，地面高度变化与实心来源由原几何父认证。原16接触/17点求解预算仍适用；未解残量报movement_solver_limit且整推进父保before，不伪装障碍或成功。

displacement_advance_binding.restore: 原接纳/历史规则包逐项证明24键快照；完整真实推进链核e、每步预算/首次阻挡event及其hit_obstruction=true。若blocked引用非null须指同动作已完成移动阶段首次实际接触，不能指前摇/后摇/其他动作或将来T。stop来源须原共同父确实释放本旧生命/旧scope占用；已停止不得再模拟，复活不重绑旧根。完整玩家占用联合及输入/阶段/生命周期完整父继续待。

remaining_auxiliary_policy.eligibility: correct class/level/exact declared rank/prerequisite, deduct exact listed original practice or explicit hero level1000 project cost once; no extra silver/fame/book gate. No absent-field default.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.cast: living idle and activity permits, valid weapon when declared. Pay mana/start cooldown once; paid interruption has no refund. Source state and parameters snapshot on activation. Blood devil martial zero-cost override still applies.
remaining_auxiliary_policy.stat_order: nonfamily base plus strongest flat contribution in each named family; archer stance and awakening multiply respective sources once before rage/weakening.
